description: The Republic of Ireland's Health Service Executive (HSE) has approved osimertinib for reimbursement as a monotherapy treatment option as a first-line treatment for adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) with activating epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) mutations.
